title: Wodonga VIC - Remediate the Network
current_summary: Planned works by an upstream provider will occur in Wodonga VIC on Thursday 8 October 2026 between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM AEDT. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected starting at 8:00 AM AEDT. Customers in the area may temporarily lose internet connectivity during this window. We will monitor progress and share updates if the schedule changes.

updates.content: We will be supporting planned network maintenance affecting Wodonga VIC on Thursday 8 October 2026 between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM AEDT. An interruption of up to 3 hours is expected from 8:00 AM AEDT. During this time, some customers may lose internet connectivity. Services should restore once the work is completed, with the maintenance window ending by 5:00 PM AEDT. If available, you may wish to use mobile data during the interruption. We will continue to monitor and provide updates if anything changes. Thank you for your patience.
